project.name: eXist-db Distributions
project.description: Distributions for eXist-db NoSQL Database Client/Server

arguments.argument: for jar in "${mac.bundle.java.dir}"/jline-*.jar "${mac.bundle.java.dir}"/jansi-*.jar; do [ -f "$jar" ] && zip -d "$jar" "org/jline/nativ/Mac/x86/libjlinenative.jnilib" || true; done

shopt -s nullglob; set -- "${project.build.directory}"/*.dmg "${project.build.directory}"/*.tar.bz2 "${project.build.directory}"/*.zip; [ $# -gt 0 ] && { gh release create "eXist-${project.version}" --title "eXist-db ${project.version}" --generate-notes "$@" || gh release upload "eXist-${project.version}" "$@" --clobber; } || echo "No distribution archives found to upload"
